title: Behavior Look At Target
description: Compels an entity to look at the target by rotating the head bone pose within a set limit.

angle_of_view_horizontal.description: The angle in degrees that the mob can see rotated on the Y-axis (left-right). Value must be <= 360.

angle_of_view_vertical.description: The angle in degrees that the mob can see rotated on the X-axis (up-down). Value must be <= 360.

look_distance.description: The distance in blocks from which the entity will look at the nearest entity.

look_time.description: Time range to look at the nearest entity.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

probability.description: The probability of looking at the target. A value of 1.00 is 100%. Value must be <= 1.
